notes.debt_payment: Fixed nominal contract (student loan, car loan, credit card); never scaled.
notes.gas: The transport index mixes fuel, vehicle, transit and taxi prices.
notes.healthcare: Not priced by the source. Premiums and out-of-pocket costs come from the healthcare model (employer, ACA, Medicare).
notes.insurance: Contract priced by the insurer, not by local consumer prices; never scaled by this index.
notes.mortgage: Fixed nominal contract on the old home; never scaled. A home bought after the move is priced with home_price by the housing model.
notes.other: Use overall_single or overall_family according to household size.
notes.property_tax: Follows the home's assessed value and local rate; handled by the housing model.

reference: item-wise median price across United States cities = 100
